    if (pos != length - 3 and

        str_input[pos + 1] == 'o' and 
        str_input[pos + 2] == 't'):
        result += "."

          str_input[pos] == 'a' and 
          str_input[pos + 1] == 't' and 
          replaced_at == 0):
        result += "@"
        pos += 2
        replaced_at = 1
    else:
        result += str_input[pos]
        pos += 1

print(result)
